column1: # The OPSD paper's baseline arms, one per line, tab-separated. opsd_baselines.sh and baseline_report.py read this file.
# - agent: the agent dir in the main-track repo (agents/<agent>); zip: its validated zip in /scratch/$USER/gemma4/submissions.
# - first_run: the run name of the arm's first run (submit_baseline.sh names it <agent>_v28_zip). Later runs are
#   <first_run>_r<k>, where k counts all of the arm's runs. extra_runs: other runs of the same files ("-" if none).
# - ref: the arm baseline_report.py compares against, task by task. kaggle: the same zip's public-board score.
